title: How AI chips are made · Chip Supply Chain
description: A free, sourced introduction to how AI chips are made and who makes each part, in {chapters} chapters from chip design to the data center.

title: How chips are designed with EDA software
description: How chip design software lays out billions of transistors. Synopsys, Cadence and Siemens EDA took over 85 percent of an $18 billion market in 2025.

title: How silicon wafers are made
description: How quartz becomes the silicon wafers chips are built on. Firms based in Japan, Taiwan, Germany and South Korea make most 300 mm wafers for advanced chips.

title: Photoresist and the chemicals used to make chips
description: How photoresist and hundreds of other chemicals and gases are used to make chips. Japanese companies held 78 percent of world photoresist sales in 2023.

title: How ASML's EUV lithography machines work
description: How extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography prints the finest layers of a chip. ASML, a Dutch firm, is the only maker of these machines and sold 48 in 2025.

title: What photomasks and pellicles are
description: What a photomask and its pellicle are, and why an EUV mask is a mirror. Only three firms make the blank plates for EUV masks.

title: How deposition and etch build a chip
description: How deposition and etch tools build a chip layer by layer. Applied Materials, Lam Research, Tokyo Electron and ASM International make most of them.

title: How wafer metrology and inspection work
description: How chip factories measure wafers and find defects between steps. KLA held 56.8 percent of the market for these tools in 2025, by CSET's count.

title: How chip foundries like TSMC make transistors
description: How fabs build gate-all-around transistors, and why only TSMC, Intel and Samsung can make the newest chips. TSMC's six largest plants are all in Taiwan.

title: What HBM is and who makes it
description: What high bandwidth memory (HBM) is and how it is stacked. SK hynix took 63.2 percent of HBM revenue in 2025, ahead of Samsung and Micron.

title: How advanced packaging like TSMC's CoWoS works
description: How advanced packaging joins AI chips and memory. Epoch AI estimates that Nvidia, Google, AMD and Amazon used around 90 percent of CoWoS capacity in 2025.

title: What chip substrates and PCBs are
description: What a package substrate does. Ajinomoto said in June 2026 that it holds over 95 percent of the market for the insulating film inside high-end packages.

title: How chips are tested and assembled
description: How chips are tested on the wafer and after packaging. Japan's Advantest took about 65 percent of 2025 spending on chip testers, by its own estimate.

title: How AI chips are networked together
description: How 72 AI chips are wired into one rack and run as one computer. In 2026 the lasers for the optical links that carry their signals were scarce.

title: How AI data centers get their power
description: Why AI data centers take years to connect to the grid. One rack can draw 142 kilowatts, and large transformers commonly took three years to arrive in 2024.

title: What Nvidia's B200 AI chip costs to make
description: Epoch AI estimated in December 2025 that Nvidia's B200 cost about $6,400 to build, mostly for memory and packaging. Its processor silicon cost about $900.

title: Who controls the chip supply chain
description: Why few governments can use export controls well. Since 2018 the United States has used them to limit China's access to advanced chips and chipmaking tools.

title: The AI chip supply chain in brief
description: The {stages} stages of the AI chip supply chain in one read, with who leads each and how concentrated it is. A four-page PDF is included.

title: AI chips compared
description: Specs for 38 AI chips, from the A100 of 2020 to chips shipping in 2026. Each lists the foundry, memory supplier and packaging plant where published.

title: Who makes what in the AI chip supply chain
description: What each of the 226 firms in the AI chip supply chain makes, where it is based and how hard it would be to replace. Revenue comes from company filings.

title: Chip export controls since 2018
description: A timeline of the main chip export rules since 2018 and what can still be sold to China. Company filings show China's share of revenue at 24 firms.

title: Glossary of chip terms
description: Plain definitions of 208 terms from the AI chip supply chain, each linked to the chapters that use it.
